characters.name: Prinsessen
characters.description: A stunningly beautiful princess, known for her delicate and flawless appearance. She is of average height with a slender build, having long, flowing blonde hair that cascades down her back. Her facial features are soft and elegant, with bright blue eyes and a gentle smile. The princess wears a lavish gown in shades of pastel, adorned with intricate embroideries, fitting for royal occasions. She is often seen standing near the large linden tree in the palace garden, surrounded by the lush greenery and flowers of the idyllic setting.

characters.name: Onkelen (Rakkeren)
characters.description: The princess's uncle, a humble and rugged figure resembling a ragpicker. He has a rugged appearance with a scruffy beard and unkempt dark hair. Wearing clothes that are simple and somewhat tattered, he possesses a rugged charm. Despite his modest appearance, he has a warm demeanor. He is often depicted engaged in conversation with the princess under the shade of the linden tree, providing a contrast to her pristine beauty with his more rugged, everyday look.

characters.name: Præsten
characters.description: A preacher, depicted as an older man with a wise and kindly demeanor. He is tall and lean, with graying hair and a well-groomed beard. His eyes are observant and reflective, often contemplating the larger questions of life. The priest wears traditional clerical robes, suitable for his profession, and is seen walking through a rustic, countryside landscape, approaching the princess near the linden tree.

characters.name: Kammerpigerne
characters.description: The chambermaids are depicted as a group of young women, each with distinct features yet a common uniform attire typical of servants in the palace. They have tidy, neatly styled hair and wear simple, practical dresses in muted tones, suitable for their duties within the palace. Often captured in scenes gossiping amongst themselves, they exchange whispered conversations and curious glances about the princess's mysterious meetings under the linden tree, embodying a sense of intrigue and camaraderie.
